narrative.title: Chapter 1 — The Signal
paras: Earth will die. The air will grow cold and the water will turn bad. Most people will feel fear. But one night, Era can hear a call from far space. We call it The Last Signal.
The Last Signal can tell of a new home. We know it from Orion. Era will leave Earth. She can join a small group of people. They will travel to space in Aurora.

narrative.title: Chapter 2 — The Small Group
paras: They meet Kai and Vega. Kai can lead the group. Vega can read the star and the light. Era can find the way with Era's mind.
Aurora, Star, Hope, and Light will leave Earth. They will fly to space with the group. The Last Signal will show the way.

narrative.title: Chapter 3 — Into Space
paras: They fly far from Earth. The air will grow still and the dark will come. Aurora can move fast through the night.
Era can watch the star light from the window. She can hear the voice of The Last Signal. The voice will give hope to the group.

narrative.title: Chapter 4 — The Edge of Orion
paras: They reach the end of Orion. The dark will stay deep. A big risk will come to the group.
Aurora can lose power. The light will fail. Kai will lead the group to a new home. They must find a way to live.

narrative.title: Chapter 5 — The Storm
paras: A wall of rock will hit Aurora. Aurora will rock. Era can hold the control.
They will fight the wall. Vega can read the star and the light. She will show the way out. The group will stay strong.

narrative.title: Chapter 6 — Lost and Found
paras: They will lose the way for a time. The dark will cover Aurora. Era can use the star to find the road.
Vega will send a call to Star. Star will answer with a light. The group will find the way home.

narrative.title: Chapter 7 — The New World
paras: They will reach a new world. The air will be clean and the water will be good. The ground will grow green.
People will leave Aurora. They will walk on the open ground. They will plant a garden and a tree.

narrative.title: Chapter 8 — Building Home
paras: The group will build a small house. They will use rock from the ground. Kai will lead the work.
Vega will make a plan for the water. Era will teach the child to read the star. They will share the food and the hope.

narrative.title: Chapter 9 — Friends and Family
paras: A child will find a small animal near the water. The group will keep it as a friend.
They will sing a song at night. They will dance under the light of the star. The people will become a family.

narrative.title: Chapter 10 — The Last Signal Lives
paras: The Last Signal will live in the heart of the group. Era can look at the star and smile. She will know that hope will stay.
The people will build a new home in Orion. They will teach the child to love the star. The Last Signal will help the people for a long time.
